lines.text: Many learners say: I am very exciting about the trip.
Better: I am very excited about the trip.
I feel excited. A trip is exciting.
Excited! I am excited about the party.

data.wrong: I am very exciting about the trip.
data.right: I am very excited about the trip.
data.why: I feel excited. A trip is exciting.

native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I am very exciting about the trip.”. O certo é “I am very excited about the trip.”. Quem sente é “excited”; o que causa a emoção é “exciting”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “excited”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: For feelings we use “-ed”: “excited”. For things, “-ing”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I am very exciting about the trip.”. The right way is “I am very excited about the trip.”. The person who feels is “excited”; the thing that causes it is “exciting”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
